description: The same title at three anchors over one colour plate: white `LEFT` anchored top-left, blue `MIDDLE` centred by saying nothing, and yellow `RIGHT` anchored bottom-right. Every clip has an offset of zero, so what separates the three is the anchor and nothing else — which is the point. A build that ignored the field would stack all three words in the middle of the frame, on top of each other; one that anchored the frame rather than the wrapped block would spread them to the raster's own edges instead of the block's; and one that let `align` centre a line in the frame rather than in its block would pull the outer two back towards the middle. All three failures are visible as pixels rather than as nobody noticing.
